FIELDS.NAME: Sunshine Window Treatments
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Sunshine Window Treatments, we specialize in providing high-quality window treatment and blind solutions for both residential and light commercial clients. Our core operations include the sale, custom fabrication, and professional services for various window coverings, including shades, blinds, and shutters. We prioritize safety and quality in our offerings, ensuring that all processes are handled by our trained and certified personnel. We source our products from reputable manufacturers and maintain strong relationships with industry suppliers to ensure the availability of the latest designs and materials. In addition, we implement strict quality control procedures and conduct regular staff training on new products and techniques to enhance our operational efficiency and reduce risks. Overall, we are committed to delivering exceptional value to our customers through quality products and professional service while adhering to safety standards.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred due to water damage from a burst pipe during operations on 07/15/2023, amounting to $1,200. Claim is currently closed, and the damages have been fully resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security service for monitoring and protection of premises.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost at actual cost value
